name: iskra
title: Iskra
description: A screenshot toolkit: capture, annotate, OCR, QR scan
author: JaINTP

commands.name: area
commands.title: Capture Area
commands.subtitle: Capture a selected area of your screen.
commands.description: Capture a selected area of your screen.

commands.name: manage-tools
commands.title: Manage Tools
commands.subtitle: Check and install screenshot tools
commands.description: View which capture, annotation, and clipboard tools are installed and copy install commands for any that are missing

commands.name: ocr
commands.title: OCR Scan & Copy
commands.subtitle: Extract text from screen region
commands.description: Capture a screen region and perform OCR to extract text

commands.name: scan-qr
commands.title: Scan QR Code
commands.subtitle: Decode QR/barcode from screen region
commands.description: Capture a screen region and decode a QR code or barcode

preferences.name: screenshot_tool
preferences.title: Screenshot Tool
preferences.description: The tool used to capture screenshots. 'Auto-detect' picks the first available one.

preferences.name: capture_order
preferences.title: Screenshot Fallback Order
preferences.description: Comma-separated tool ids tried in order when the chosen tool cannot run: grimblast, grim, spectacle, gnome-screenshot, flameshot, maim, scrot, screencapture, noctalia, screenshot-desktop. Empty keeps auto-detection. A tool missing from this list follows in the built-in order.

preferences.name: post_capture
preferences.title: Capture Hand-off
preferences.description: Where the screenshot is handled once taken. Vicinae preview keeps it in a temporary file and offers save, copy and annotate actions. Native hand-off saves it straight to the screenshot directory and leaves the desktop tool's own notification and editor in charge.

data.title: Hand off to the native tool

preferences.name: annotation_tool
preferences.title: Annotation Tool
preferences.description: Tool used to annotate screenshots. Auto-reload tools (Satty, swappy) rewrite the file and reload the preview. Manual tools (Noctalia, Gradia, Spectacle, GIMP, Pinta, Paint) save on their own, so the preview cannot follow them.

preferences.name: annotation_order
preferences.title: Annotation Fallback Order
preferences.description: Comma-separated tool ids tried in order when the chosen annotator cannot run: noctalia, satty, swappy, gradia, spectacle, gimp, pinta, mspaint. A tool missing from this list is still reachable - it follows in the built-in order.

preferences.name: annotation_flow
preferences.title: After Capture
preferences.description: What the annotation tool does once the main Screenshot command has a screenshot. Notify first saves the capture — the button's action runs after the command is gone. Preview leaves the annotator to the Annotate action.

preferences.name: copy_to_clipboard
preferences.title: Copy to Clipboard
preferences.label: Copy to clipboard automatically
preferences.description: Whether to copy the screenshot to the clipboard

preferences.name: save_to_file
preferences.title: Save to File
preferences.label: Save to file automatically
preferences.description: Whether to save the screenshot to a file

preferences.name: subfolder_format
preferences.title: Subfolder Format
preferences.description: Folder name format (e.g. %d-%m-%Y). Omit to save directly in screenshot path.

preferences.name: autoclose_vicinae
preferences.title: Autoclose Vicinae
preferences.label: Close Vicinae after saving or copying
preferences.description: Automatically close Vicinae after saving a screenshot to file or copying it to the clipboard

scripts.test: tsx --tsconfig test/tsconfig.test.json test/naming.test.ts && tsx --tsconfig test/tsconfig.test.json test/backend.test.ts && tsx --tsconfig test/tsconfig.test.json test/scan.test.ts
